name: ANT Precision Industry Co., Ltd
summary: ANT Precision Industry Co., Ltd, established in 1988 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, operates as a global manufacturer and supplier. The company specializes in the production and distribution of various components, including connectors, wire harnesses, and integrated module solutions, catering to both Taiwanese and international markets. Its diverse product lineup encompasses high-precision mold and die parts, stainless-steel components, and specialized connectors and wire harnesses designed for automotive and industrial applications. Furthermore, ANT develops comprehensive modules, which incorporate elements like connectors, cables, PCBAs, housings, and other critical components. Beyond manufacturing, the firm provides an array of advanced services, such as precision machining, injection molding, stamping, assembly, and automation. Its offerings are utilized by clients across the automotive, industrial, and medical sectors.
